answers.core: It makes the most sense to be a core feature of the engine as it gives the user a different option and more control over a common operation. That way the engine isn't forcing only one particular behavior onto the user.
answers.workaround: I suspect there are a great number of people that could find this feature very useful for their daily workflow. Other developers have complained about this exact problem [before](http://www.zarkonnen.com/godot_jam_postmortem#:~:text=The%20file%20chooser%20does%20not%20remember%20previous%20locations.).

title: Add "Remember Path" setting for attaching scripts to nodes
